title: CodeAnswer
description: JSON schema for code explanation and technical query responses generated by LDrago Coding Brain

answer.description: Comprehensive, technical, grounded response to the code inquiry

citations.description: Source code references and grounded evidence supporting the answer

symbol.description: Fully-qualified symbol name, function, class, or method

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions made where context was incomplete or unverified

confidence.description: Assessed confidence level based on available evidence

confidence_notes.description: Justification for the assigned confidence score

follow_up_suggestions.description: Suggested next steps or investigative actions for the developer
